Showdown FPS combines precision gunplay with anime-inspired Jutsus in a Shibuya-inspired world.
Prime Heroes is our Roblox-exclusive team hero shooter, set in the original Prime universe and entering early access with six playable heroes.

Meet Gurnoor. If there’s one thing you can count on, it’s that he’ll always ask why. Driven by logic and curiosity, he’s constantly looking for better ways to solve problems, improve systems, and turn ideas into reality.

Whether it’s designing complex game mechanics, building clever workarounds, or tackling challenges head-on, Gurnoor believes in making things happen rather than waiting for them to happen. His personal motto says it best: “See the Outcome, Make it Happen.” 🎯

Often the first to walk in and the last to call it a day, Gurnoor brings dedication and a relentless drive to every project he takes on.

➡️ Swipe to learn more about Gurnoor’s journey in Game Design.

Some moments bring people together, and Birthdays are one of them.

At SuperGaming, we’ve turned birthday celebrations into a small tradition of storytelling through personalised meme cakes, built around inside jokes, iconic memories, everyday quirks, and the moments teammates remember most about each other.

There’s something special about seeing a room instantly understand the story behind a cake without a single explanation needed.

Because at the heart of every celebration is something simple, people who genuinely know and appreciate each other ✨ 


#lifeatsupergaming #culture #people","url":"https://www.linkedin.com/posts/supg_lifeatsupergaming-culture-people-activity-7466108997163687936-y6X9"},{"@context":"http://schema.org","@type":"SocialMediaPosting","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"SuperGaming","url":"https://in.linkedin.com/company/supg"},"datePublished":"2026-05-25T11:14:42.151Z","interactionStatistic":{"@type":"InteractionCounter","interactionType":"http://schema.org/LikeAction","userInteractionCount":27},"mainEntityOfPage":"https://www.linkedin.com/posts/supg_women-in-game-development-in-india-careers-activity-7464635050152771585-3Do3","text":"India's gaming industry is booming, but who's building it?

Outlook Respawn's latest piece shines a light on the women driving change behind the scenes, and Christelle D'cruz, SuperGaming's Co-Founder & VP Engineering, is a standout example.

From building educational games to developing multiplayer shooters played by millions, Christelle’s journey reflects the kind of innovation and resilience that continues to shape the future of Indian gaming.

The pipeline of women in game development, especially engineering, is still thin. Stories like Christelle's matter because representation in the room shapes what gets built, and for whom.

Full read in the link below:
https://lnkd.in/dpVnsbUw

#WomenInGaming #GameDev #IndianGaming #SuperGaming #Inclusion","url":"https://www.linkedin.com/posts/supg_women-in-game-development-in-india-careers-activity-7464635050152771585-3Do3"},{"@context":"http://schema.org","@type":"SocialMediaPosting","author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"SuperGaming","url":"https://in.linkedin.com/company/supg"},"datePublished":"2026-05-08T11:22:04.830Z","interactionStatistic":{"@type":"InteractionCounter","interactionType":"http://schema.org/LikeAction","userInteractionCount":103},"mainEntityOfPage":"https://www.linkedin.com/posts/supg_games-lifeatsupergaming-people-activity-7458476313184514049-6z5y","text":"What makes a game truly fun? 🦦 
It’s a question we think about often while building games.

Recently, during one of our Game Nights at SuperGaming, we got to experience that question from the player’s side again. 
From board games to console battles, Game Night is our space to compete, connect, unwind, and simply play together.

From the quick chaos of Dobble,
to the competitive edge of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate,
the psychological play of Mafia,
and the wild unpredictability of Cards Against Humanity
every game brought out a different side of play.

Some games created tension.
Some sparked loud laughter across the room.
Some demanded strategy and teamwork.
Others were pure chaos.

And somewhere between the wins, losses, and everything in between, we realised something important:
Fun looks different for everyone.

For some, it’s competition.
For others, it’s strategy, unpredictability, storytelling, teamwork,
or simply the people they get to play with 💛 

And as game developers, nights like these are a reminder that building great games starts with understanding the many different ways people experience joy through play. ✨

From a core team that began building together in 2007 to creating games played by more than 200 million people around the world.

    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">What makes a game truly fun? 🦦 
It’s a question we think about often while building games.

Recently, during one of our Game Nights at SuperGaming, we got to experience that question from the player’s side again. 
From board games to console battles, Game Night is our space to compete, connect, unwind, and simply play together.

From the quick chaos of Dobble,
to the competitive edge of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate,
the psychological play of Mafia,
and the wild unpredictability of Cards Against Humanity
every game brought out a different side of play.

Some games created tension.
Some sparked loud laughter across the room.
Some demanded strategy and teamwork.
Others were pure chaos.

And somewhere between the wins, losses, and everything in between, we realised something important:
Fun looks different for everyone.

For some, it’s competition.
For others, it’s strategy, unpredictability, storytelling, teamwork,
or simply the people they get to play with 💛
